name: Ragged mapping whose caller relies on the rounded tail faulting
required_postconditions: every byte past the requested 4097 bytes stays unmapped and faults on access

failure_sink.description: the case writes both the first surplus byte and the last byte of the host-rounded page

extraction_limitations: The case derives the rounded length from sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE) on the executing host instead of assuming a 4 KiB page.
x_groundtruth: mmap rounds 4097 bytes to 8192 on a 4 KiB host and 16384 on Apple Silicon. A successful write in that tail is the counterexample the declared guarantee requires.
